_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of Microsoft's request and response examples for the Managed Identity REST API (Microsoft.ManagedIdentity 2024-11-30), the examples Learn's REST reference pages render for creating a federated identity credential on a user-assigned managed identity and for creating and reading the identity. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Microsoft REST examples: Managed Identity 2024-11-30 (federated identity credential create, identity create and get)
files_last_changed: 2025-09-12 (commit 37886acc4980d7ac8753fafe90619cae296eb477, the last commit to the three examples); unchanged at the repository's head on 2026-10-30
license: MIT (LICENSE, copied from the repository root).
not_copied: The other nine examples in the same folder (delete, list, update, operations, the system-assigned identity read): Chapter 05 sends only the federated credential PUT, the identity PUT and the identity GET these three show.

The OpenAPI files themselves, the preview API versions (2025-05-31-preview, which adds claimsMatchingExpression) and every other API version: the chapter cites the Learn REST reference pages rendered from them.
